### 🌐 English only
- The game now ships in English only. The language switch in Settings is gone until a second language is added.
- The trader's spoken greeting is in English.

### ⌨️ Hotbar keys
- Weapon slots are the number keys **1–5**, and they now work on **any keyboard layout** — the game reads the key itself, so the caps marked 1–5 select your hotbar even on layouts that type something else there unshifted (a Czech one gives + ě š č ř, a French one & é " ').
- Rebinding a slot stores the digit printed on the key you pressed, so Settings → Controls always names the key you actually press.
